cover.alt: Pastel houses stacked up a hill at sunset
cover.dek: Ten days of hills, tiles and custard tarts, and a few things that happened before that.

letter.body:
It's been a full season. Work swallowed most of the summer, so in September I took ten days off and went to Lisbon. I mostly walked uphill and ate custard tarts.

This is the first of these postcards. Every season I'll send one: what I've been up to, a few photos, and one question for you at the bottom. Please answer it. That's the part I'm most excited about.

lately.title: Three things since we last talked

items.title: Launched the big project
items.text: Eight months of work went live in September. I slept through most of the weekend after.

items.title: Finally nailed Mom's dal
items.text: Three video calls and four attempts. Attempt four was worth it.

items.title: Ran my first 10K
items.text: 58:12. I'm told mentioning the medal is mandatory.

moment.title: Tram 28, golden hour
moment.caption: Graça, 7:48 pm
moment.story: I rode it three times in one evening to catch this light on the climb up to Graça. By the third lap the driver was waving at me.

mailbag.question: What's the best thing you ate this summer?

notes.text: A peach from a roadside stand in Yamanashi. I'm still thinking about it.
notes.name: Aiko

notes.text: My grandma's jollof at the family reunion. Nothing else comes close.
notes.name: Amara

notes.text: Cold cherry soup by a lake. Don't knock it until you try it.
notes.name: Lena
